scope: Game art and interaction guidance for all current popup and pause surfaces

sources.title: What we can learn from diegetic UI in gaming
sources.author: Mia Ellis-Lee / Flywheel Strategic
sources.readMethod: Browser search result followed to full article
sources.type: Design commentary with Dead Space and Resident Evil 6 examples
sources.takeaway: Object-related information, consistency and unobtrusive placement matter more than merely using a fictional device.

sources.title: Ghost of Tsushima guide: How to use the Guiding Wind
sources.author: Jeff Ramos / Polygon
sources.readMethod: Browser search result followed to full article
sources.type: Gameplay guide documenting actual target and navigation controls
sources.takeaway: A player selects a target, then requests scene guidance while a concise target identifier stays available.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 101: Text display
sources.readMethod: Full official page in browser; old gaming URL redirected to xbox
sources.takeaway: Readable font, spacing, bounded line width and stable text containers; decorative titles do not replace legible body text.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 113: UI focus handling
sources.readMethod: Official page through its guideline navigation; full main article read
sources.takeaway: Focus must be obvious, remain visible, and never move into hidden controls.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 117: Visual distractions and motion settings
sources.readMethod: Official guideline navigation; full main article read
sources.takeaway: Allow nonessential motion to be disabled and avoid moving reading backgrounds.

sources.title: Ensure interactive elements / virtual controls are large and well spaced
sources.readMethod: HTTP 200 article body, including cursor-driven interface guidance
sources.takeaway: Sufficient target size and separation also matter for mouse precision. The project's 42px PC target is its own implementation choice.

limits: No quantitative player-effect claim follows from these sources.
No competitor artwork is copied into the game.
Only relevant XAG principles are adopted; full certification is not claimed.
Unrelated search results and failed direct network attempts are excluded from evidence.
